rules.headline_benchmark: frozen cases whose expectation digest matches and whose review verifies
rules.author_review_is_not_enough: a case reviewed only by its author is eligible for regression, not for the headline accuracy number
rules.isolation: this corpus must not be loaded by the chat app or the retrieval index; expected answers stay out of the live learning corpus
rules.digest: expected_graph_sha256 covers the canonical JSON of expect, so a silent edit is a mismatch
